title: search-box across indices gets reset after selecting filter in multi-index.
body:
**Bug 🐞**

### What is the current behavior?
It is a nuxt solution.

I have a search page. With 3 indices, I have a search-box which is global above all indices. Then 3 ais-index under this search box. When I have routing on this my search-box get's reset on any facet changes. 

Can't I search across all indices without haveing it inside ais-index? it works when searching. But it gets reset on any changes in the filter and it does not a apply the search to the url.

Here is an image of the filter:

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/65391517/138693800-e91b241e-f7c8-4e5a-8a17-2b7443310c17.png)


### Make a sandbox with the current behavior
https://codesandbox.io/s/vigilant-shadow-syliy?file=/src/App.vue 

I wrote a test code for this, iknow it is in hte normal vue template and not nuxt, but the setup would be the same and could not find a template for nuxt.

### What is the expected behavior?

The expected behavior is to save the query in url and not reset it when adding a facet / setting a facet

### Does this happen only in specific situations?
when change in the facets is detected.


### What is the version you are using?

"algoliasearch": "^4.10.5",
"vue-instantsearch": "^3.7.0",

> Always try the latest one before opening an issue.

comments.body:
I edited your sandbox slightly to use the builtin router, as there's no vue router in the sandbox you created, but the refinements don't reset the query for me: https://codesandbox.io/s/fancy-river-yo5yf?file=/src/App.vue

Do you have more info?

@Haroenv  Thanks for answering so quickly :) 

Can you link me to the nuxt template, then I'll try to make you a reproduce in there.

all templates are here: https://instantsearch-templates.netlify.app, nuxt specifically is https://codesandbox.io/s/github/algolia/vue-instantsearch/tree/master/examples/nuxt (although the Vue InstantSearch dependency needs to be changed to npm: https://codesandbox.io/s/holy-brook-b3y1p)
@Haroenv  https://codesandbox.io/s/tender-fast-2nh74?file=/src/App.vue When you write in the search-box here :) it does not get included in the url

Hmm, this indeed seems to be a bug where the ui state in routing only seems to reflect the direct state of an index that gets repeated (in this case with the root one). A workaround is making sure there's a different query for the root as for that unique index. 

In my example I made sure the root index gets `__root__` as index name / index id, which then gets filtered out in the implementation for the search client.

https://codesandbox.io/s/competent-sky-cex6n?file=/src/App.vue

I think this *is* a bug somehow in the routing, but not sure what the solution it up to now. Workaround is making sure no index names / index id's are repeated

Not sure what you mean with "go to a record"? can you reproduce that part in the sandbox too? I assume something else is trying to read from that initial result, which doesn't exist anymore. 

alternatively you can rely on just avoiding repeated index-id https://codesandbox.io/s/late-lake-0hx9q?file=/src/App.vue
